ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What would happen if the cat population decreased?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image shows a food web. On the right side there is a node labeled "rabbits", below it there is a node labeled "cats", and there is an arrow from rabbits to cats. Reasoning: In a food web, arrows usually indicate energy flowing from the organism being eaten to the predator, therefore the arrow from rabbits to cats indicates that cats eat rabbits, and cats are predators of rabbits. If the number of cats decreases, the predation pressure on rabbits will decrease, so the number of rabbits will increase.
